name: Public
description: Public lets agents read the accounts, portfolio, order history and market quotes of a Public customer, and preview and place orders. Each user signs in to their own Public account through the browser, and an order placed through it is a real order with real money.

prompts.text: Summarize my Public portfolio and how it moved today.
What are the latest quotes for AAPL and MSFT?
Which of my orders filled this week?

apps.name: Public
apps.description: Accounts, portfolio, market data and orders, over Public's MCP server with browser sign-in.
